english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for “during that time” in everyday Cantonese.
Use this when “then” refers to a particular time in the past, rather than to what happens next.

examples.english: I was still living in Mong Kok whilst you were studying abroad.
examples.jyutping: go2 zan6 si4 ngo5 zung6 zyu6 hai2 wong6 gok3

examples.english: Back then, I still lived in Mong Kok.
examples.jyutping: go2 zan6 si4 ngo5 zung6 zyu6 hai2 wong6 gok3
